rule: Every value below was parsed from Source/ by the generator. No value is hand-typed (Master Directive v1 rule R1).

entries.name: HazardRadius
entries.comment: Hazard radius (cm).

entries.name: LifetimeSeconds
entries.comment: Total lifetime before dissipating (s).

entries.name: DamagePerSecond
entries.comment: Damage per second applied to players inside (pre-mitigation).

entries.name: BlastRadius
entries.comment: Visual blast radius the disc should cover (cm) — call before adding to the world.

entries.name: TelegraphDuration
entries.comment: How long the warning shows before detonation (matches the boss timer).

entries.name: bIsOpen
entries.comment: FR-9: door state (toggled through Interact; replicated for clients).

entries.name: StorageCapacity
entries.comment: FR-9: crate capacity in distinct stacks.

entries.name: CurrentHealth
entries.comment: IAstrawildInteractable (audit C-2): Research Desk spends points on the next tech.

entries.name: PlacementReach
entries.comment: Placement reach in cm.

entries.name: SnapGridSize
entries.comment: Grid snap size (cm).

entries.name: ResonatorItemId
entries.comment: Item consumed per capture attempt (directive §8 capture device).

entries.name: TrackingDistance
entries.comment: Distance within which the player is "tracking" the target (capture bonus).

entries.name: RangedAttackCooldown
entries.comment: Cooldown between projectile shots (ranged weapons ignore the melee stamina economy).

entries.name: ProjectileSpawnOffset
entries.comment: Forward offset from the player capsule where the bolt spawns (cm).

entries.name: DodgeInvulnerabilitySeconds
entries.comment: Invulnerability window inside the dodge (directive §9 i-frames).

entries.name: UnarmedBlockMitigation
entries.comment: Unarmed block mitigation — a shield overrides this with its own value (wave 3).

entries.name: ArmorMaxFraction
entries.comment: Hard cap on armor damage reduction — damage is never fully nullified (design sanity).

entries.name: StaggerDamageThreshold
entries.comment: Incoming hits at or above this (post-mitigation) stagger the player.

entries.name: PlayerStaggerSeconds
entries.comment: How long the player staggers when the threshold triggers.

entries.name: bIsBlocking
entries.comment: Effective per-hit damage: weapon profile + equipped-item attack bonus.

entries.name: DamageMultiplier
entries.comment: Bonus damage multiplier applied to the triggering ability hit.

entries.name: StatusId
entries.comment: Status id applied to the target (empty = pure damage reaction).

entries.name: StationId
entries.comment: Registry id of this station kind (e.g. Station_Workbench, Station_Campfire).

entries.name: Sanity
entries.comment: Sustained-risk band — illness can only be contracted below this.

entries.name: IllnessId
entries.comment: Active illness id (NAME_None = healthy).

entries.name: SeedItemId
entries.comment: Seed item planted (NAME_None on empty plots).

entries.name: FoodValue
entries.comment: Consumable: hunger/thirst restoration (directive §11).

entries.name: HealValue
entries.comment: Consumable: health restoration.

entries.name: AttackPower
entries.comment: Equipment: base attack added to player.

entries.name: BlockMitigation
entries.comment: Equipment: damage reduction fraction 0..0.8 when blocking.

entries.name: EchoFeedValue
entries.comment: Echo food preference bonus multiplier when fed this item (directive §8).

entries.name: StaminaRegenBonus
entries.comment: Exosuit: extra stamina regenerated per second.

entries.name: CarryWeightBonus
entries.comment: Exosuit: extra carry weight (kg) added to the inventory cap.

entries.name: MoveSpeedBonus
entries.comment: Exosuit: fractional walk/sprint speed bonus (0.15 = +15%).

entries.name: bIsRangedWeapon
entries.comment: Weapon: fires projectiles instead of the melee sweep (laser/energy path).

entries.name: AmmoItemId
entries.comment: Weapon: ammo item consumed per shot (NAME_None = no ammo requirement).

entries.name: ScannerSpeedMultiplier
entries.comment: Scanner: multiplier on journal observation rate while actively scanning.

entries.name: bDeploysDrone
entries.comment: Deployable: consuming this item spawns a utility drone companion.

entries.name: bDeploysRobot
entries.comment: Deployable: consuming this item spawns a utility robot worker.

entries.name: WeaponDefinitionId
entries.comment: Weapon behaviour profile (firing family, damage, VFX hooks). NAME_None = legacy stat path.

entries.name: ColdInsulationRating
entries.comment: Armor/helmet/exosuit: cold-side insulation in Celsius (0 = none).

entries.name: HeatInsulationRating
entries.comment: Armor/helmet/exosuit: heat-side insulation in Celsius (0 = none).

entries.name: ScannerRangeMultiplier
entries.comment: Scanner: observation range multiplier while equipped (1 = base 1400cm).

entries.name: bHiddenResourceDetection
entries.comment: Scanner: reveals hidden resource nodes (scanner-gated harvesting).

entries.name: bAncientSignalTracking
entries.comment: Scanner: doubles ancient-POI discovery radius + unlocks signal tracking HUD.

entries.name: DroneScanRadiusBonus
entries.comment: Drone module: adds to the drone's scan pulse radius (cm).

entries.name: DroneHarvestRadiusBonus
entries.comment: Drone module: adds to the drone's harvest radius (cm).

entries.name: DroneScanRateBonus
entries.comment: Drone module: adds to observation progress per scan pulse.

entries.name: DroneBatteryBonusSeconds
entries.comment: Drone module: extends the deployed battery capacity (seconds).

entries.name: RobotDefinitionId
entries.comment: Robot: chassis specialization id (mining/farming/defense profiles).

entries.name: HarvestMultiplier
entries.comment: Yield multiplier when the tool category matches the resource (picks x3, sickles x4).

entries.name: RequiredTechId
entries.comment: Technology that must be unlocked before this recipe is craftable (NAME_None = always).

entries.name: RequiredStationId
entries.comment: Crafting station required (NAME_None = craft anywhere).

entries.name: CaptureDifficulty
entries.comment: 0..1 — base difficulty of capture before weaken/trust factors.

entries.name: ElementalResistance
entries.comment: Flat damage reduction vs its own element.

entries.name: HungerDecayPerHour
entries.comment: Needs decay per in-game hour (directive §4 Needs).

entries.name: BaseExperienceToLevel
entries.comment: XP required to reach level 2 (scales per level).

entries.name: bHostileToPlayers
entries.comment: Hostile species attack players unprovoked (directive §21 first hostile).

entries.name: SightRadius
entries.comment: Perception range in cm (sight).

entries.name: CodexIndex
entries.comment: Codex number (1-based) shown in the journal bestiary UI.

entries.name: EvolveToDefinitionId
entries.comment: Species this one evolves into when gates are met (NAME_None = final form).

entries.name: EvolveRequiredLevel
entries.comment: Level gate (instance level must reach this).

entries.name: EvolveRequiredBond
entries.comment: Bond gate 0..100 — evolution is a relationship milestone, not a grind bar.

entries.name: DefinitionId
entries.comment: Modular building piece definition (directive §16).

entries.name: RequiredItemId
entries.comment: Item consumed from inventory when placing.

entries.name: RequiredTechId
entries.comment: Technology required before placement (NAME_None = always).

entries.name: GridCellSize
entries.comment: Grid cell size in cm this piece occupies (200 = one foundation cell).

entries.name: PowerGeneration
entries.comment: Units of power produced per second when active (Generator).

entries.name: PowerDraw
entries.comment: Units of power drawn per second when switched on (Consumer).

entries.name: BatteryCapacity
entries.comment: Battery capacity in power-seconds (Battery).

entries.name: TechId
entries.comment: Technology tree node (directive §19).

entries.name: ResearchCost
entries.comment: Research point cost to unlock.

entries.name: QuestId
entries.comment: Data-driven quest (directive §25).

entries.name: NextQuestId
entries.comment: Next quest in the chain, auto-activated on completion (NAME_None = end).

entries.name: RewardTechId
entries.comment: Tech unlocked instantly on completion (story-critical research, directive §19).

entries.name: LootTableId
entries.comment: Loot table — weighted drops (directive §6 loot).

entries.name: BonusRollChance
entries.comment: Chance 0..1 for one extra random roll from GuaranteedDrops.

entries.name: NpcId
entries.comment: NPC definition — schedule, dialogue topics, quest hooks (directive §26).

entries.name: OfferedQuestId
entries.comment: Quest offered when talked to.

entries.name: ShopLootTableId
entries.comment: Fixed shop loot table id (future extension).

entries.name: VillageId
entries.comment: Village this NPC calls home (waypoint provider id, e.g. Village_Dawnstead).

entries.name: VisualMeshScale
entries.comment: DCP-4: uniform scale for the real body (meshes differ in native size).

entries.name: DamagePerHit
entries.comment: Damage per hit BEFORE the equipped-weapon attack bonus is added.

entries.name: FireIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between shots (server-side gate).

entries.name: AmmoItemId
entries.comment: Ammo item consumed per shot (NAME_None = free).

entries.name: LockOnConeHalfAngle
entries.comment: Cone half-angle used to acquire a lock-on target (degrees).

entries.name: LockOnRange
entries.comment: Max distance a lock-on target may be acquired at (cm).

entries.name: BeamRange
entries.comment: Max trace distance (cm).

entries.name: PierceCount
entries.comment: Beam: how many enemies a single shot pierces through.

entries.name: ChainCount
entries.comment: Arc: how many extra targets the bolt chains to.

entries.name: ChainRadius
entries.comment: Arc: chain search radius around the previous target (cm).

entries.name: ChainDamageFraction
entries.comment: Fraction of the base damage carried by each arc chain hop (0..1).

entries.name: MuzzleVfxId
entries.comment: Niagara muzzle flash asset id (VFX contract: NS_AW_Weap_<MuzzleVfxId>).

entries.name: TrailVfxId
entries.comment: Niagara projectile/beam trail asset id.

entries.name: ImpactVfxId
entries.comment: Niagara impact asset id.

entries.name: FireSoundId
entries.comment: Fire sound id (audio contract: SC_AW_Weap_<FireSoundId>).

entries.name: ResourceItemId
entries.comment: Item granted per harvest — the ONLY source of truth (never empty for valid defs).

entries.name: bRequiresScannerDetection
entries.comment: Hidden veins: harvestable only while a scanner with HiddenResourceDetection is equipped.

entries.name: VisualScale
entries.comment: Visual scale of the placeholder mesh.

entries.name: SpecialistWorkRate
entries.comment: Work rate when the site's WorkType matches PrimaryWorkType.

entries.name: GenericWorkRate
entries.comment: Work rate on every other site type.

entries.name: MoveSpeedMultiplier
entries.comment: Movement speed multiplier toward its site.

entries.name: OutputItemId
entries.comment: Item produced per completed cycle.

entries.name: SecondsPerOutput
entries.comment: Seconds of worker time per output cycle.

entries.name: bRequiresPower
entries.comment: Power-gated site: no grid power → no production (Master Plan §14).

entries.name: OffsetFromZoneCenter
entries.comment: Offset from the zone center (cm).

entries.name: RarityWeight
entries.comment: Selection weight in the roll pool.

entries.name: CooldownGameHours
entries.comment: In-world hours before this event may fire again.

entries.name: MinDay
entries.comment: First day this event may appear on (progression gating).

entries.name: DurationGameMinutes
entries.comment: Duration in in-world minutes (0 = instant).

entries.name: bRequiresNight
entries.comment: Only fires between 21:00 and 06:00.

entries.name: ResearchPointReward
entries.comment: Research points granted to every player when the event resolves.

entries.name: RewardLootTableId
entries.comment: Loot table id granted at the event location (supply drop / meteor).

entries.name: SpeciesBoostId
entries.comment: Species id that spawns extra wild instances (migration / rare bloom).

entries.name: SpeciesBoostCount
entries.comment: How many extra instances the boost spawns.

entries.name: RaidHostileCount
entries.comment: Hostiles spawned near the player camp (night raid).

entries.name: bForcesWeather
entries.comment: Event cares about weather state (display only until weather coupling lands).

entries.name: OffsetFromZoneCenter
entries.comment: Offset from the zone center (cm) — resolved at spawn.

entries.name: DiscoveryRadius
entries.comment: Discovery radius around the marker (cm).

entries.name: RewardLootTableId
entries.comment: Loot granted the first time this POI is discovered.

entries.name: ResearchReward
entries.comment: Research points granted on first discovery.

entries.name: bRequiresSignalScanner
entries.comment: Ancient signal sources: only discoverable with an ancient-signal scanner.

entries.name: DressingSetId
entries.comment: Antigravity asset contract: prop/dressing set to place at this POI.

entries.name: BiomeId
entries.comment: Zone this biome dresses (matches ZoneId in the zone table).

entries.name: bStartingBiome
entries.comment: Starting biome — the P1 vertical slice lands here first.

entries.name: DressingDensity
entries.comment: Multiplier on the zone dressing budget (0 removes that biome's scatter).

entries.name: RequiredQuestActiveId
entries.comment: Quest that must be ACTIVE (started, not completed).

entries.name: RequiredQuestCompletedId
entries.comment: Quest that must be COMPLETED.

entries.name: RequiredFlagId
entries.comment: Story flag that must be SET.

entries.name: ForbiddenFlagId
entries.comment: Story flag that must NOT be set (hide follow-ups after one-time beats).

entries.name: StartQuestId
entries.comment: Quest started when this choice is taken (routes through the quest component).

entries.name: SetFlagId
entries.comment: Story flag set when taken (persistent across sessions).

entries.name: GiveItemId
entries.comment: Item granted to the player (server-side inventory add).

entries.name: GiveResearchPoints
entries.comment: Research points granted on top of any quest rewards.

entries.name: GotoNodeId
entries.comment: Next node (NAME_None + !bEndDialogue = also ends the conversation).

entries.name: bOpenShop
entries.comment: Vendor bridge: closes the dialogue and opens this NPC's shop screen.

entries.name: bEndDialogue
entries.comment: Hard end (no follow-up node).

entries.name: NodeId
entries.comment: A conversation beat: NPC line(s) played in order, then the player picks.

entries.name: CurrentNodeId
entries.comment: Node cursor.

entries.name: PassageHalfWidth
entries.comment: Passage half-width the gate must span (cm).

entries.name: DungeonId
entries.comment: Stable dungeon id — the save system maps records to generators through it.

entries.name: RoomCount
entries.comment: Total rooms including entry and boss.

entries.name: RoomSpacing
entries.comment: Distance between consecutive room centers (cm).

entries.name: BossDefinitionId
entries.comment: Boss species definition id.

entries.name: DungeonCompletionResearchPoints
entries.comment: Audit C-4: research points granted to the shared pool when the dungeon is completed.

entries.name: BossSummonSpeciesId
entries.comment: FR-7: when set, the boss summons THIS species in phase 2 (Eye Sentinels).

entries.name: PortalId
entries.comment: Stable location id published with Event.LocationReached (quest TargetId). LCP-2: replicated for client prompts.

entries.name: Destination
entries.comment: World-space teleport destination.

entries.name: UseRadius
entries.comment: Max distance the player may stand from the portal to use it (server guard).

entries.name: RoomTypeId
entries.comment: Room shape name for the generator (e.g. "Entry", "Combat", "Puzzle", "Elite", "Boss", "Exit").

entries.name: HalfExtents
entries.comment: World-space half-extents of the room (cm).

entries.name: ClearLootTableId
entries.comment: Loot table id granted when the room is cleared.

entries.name: BossDefeatEventId
entries.comment: Batch 8: defeat event id published by this room's boss (per-dungeon quest target).

entries.name: bIsBossRoom
entries.comment: Boss room spawns the boss definition instead of creatures.

entries.name: RoomIndex
entries.comment: Sequential room index within the dungeon.

entries.name: ThinkIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between AI think steps for Tier0. Higher LOD tiers lengthen this.

entries.name: BaseFleeHealthFraction
entries.comment: Health fraction below which wild Echoes flee (scaled by personality).

entries.name: AttackRange
entries.comment: Attack reach for melee Echoes.

entries.name: FollowDistance
entries.comment: Follow distance for captured party Echoes (directive §10).

entries.name: ExploreRadius
entries.comment: Distance the creature wanders from home while exploring.

entries.name: EnrageTimerSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds until enrage regardless of health (directive §24 enrage).

entries.name: EnrageDamageMultiplier
entries.comment: Damage multiplier while enraged.

entries.name: SummonSpeciesId
entries.comment: Adds summoned at phase 2.

entries.name: BossSpeciesId
entries.comment: Species definition the boss scales from (set by the dungeon boss room).

entries.name: BossHealthScale
entries.comment: Definition MaxHealth multiplier (bosses tower over their wild kin).

entries.name: BossDamageScale
entries.comment: Definition AttackPower multiplier.

entries.name: BossStatusDurationMultiplier
entries.comment: Bosses shrug off extended CC — incoming status durations scale by this.

entries.name: SpecialAttackCooldownSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between special attacks (energy bolt phase 1+, AoE slam phase 2+).

entries.name: TelegraphDurationSeconds
entries.comment: Warning time before the AoE blast detonates (the telegraph disc lifetime).

entries.name: SpecialBlastDamage
entries.comment: AoE blast damage at the center (pre-mitigation).

entries.name: SpecialBlastRadius
entries.comment: AoE blast radius (cm).

entries.name: HazardIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between arena-hazard spawns while in phase 2+.

entries.name: BoltCount
entries.comment: DP-5: energy bolts per special volley (fanned around the target — set-tuned).

entries.name: BlastCount
entries.comment: DP-5: telegraphed blasts per special volley (the first sits on the player, the rest ring around them — set-tuned).

entries.name: HazardWaveCount
entries.comment: DP-5: hazards spawned per hazard wave (ring around the arena center — set-tuned).

entries.name: HazardDamagePerSecond
entries.comment: DP-5: damage per second of each arena hazard this boss spawns (set-tuned).

entries.name: HazardSpawnRadius
entries.comment: Hazards spawn on a ring of this radius around the arena center (cm).

entries.name: WeakPointPeriodSeconds
entries.comment: Weak point exposes every N seconds...

entries.name: WeakPointWindowSeconds
entries.comment: ...and stays vulnerable for this long (x2 damage window).

entries.name: WeakPointDamageMultiplier
entries.comment: Damage multiplier while the weak point is exposed.

entries.name: bWeakPointExposed
entries.comment: Final production run: the weak-point core is exposed (replicated so clients toggle the glow).

entries.name: bSkeletalBodyActive
entries.comment: True once the skinned body replaced the PMC silhouette.

entries.name: Bond
entries.comment: 0..100 bond with its owner (directive §4 Relationship).

entries.name: Experience
entries.comment: Accumulated growth experience (directive §4 Growth).

entries.name: OwnerPlayerId
entries.comment: Owning player id once captured (multiplayer ownership, directive §28).

entries.name: DefinitionId
entries.comment: Population record for abstract world-level simulation (directive §7).

entries.name: Tier0Distance
entries.comment: Tier0 distance (cm) — full simulation.

entries.name: Tier1Distance
entries.comment: Tier1 distance (cm) — reduced simulation.

entries.name: Tier2Distance
entries.comment: Tier2 distance (cm) — statistical simulation.

entries.name: TierUpdateIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between tier re-evaluation sweeps.

entries.name: Category
entries.comment: Originating system, e.g. "DataValidator", "AssetFallback", "Save".

entries.name: TimestampSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds since process start (FPlatformTime based, stable for one session).

entries.name: TargetId
entries.comment: Domain id: item id, echo definition, tech id, location name...

entries.name: RespawnDelaySeconds
entries.comment: Seconds before a dead player respawns.

entries.name: AutosaveIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Autosave interval in seconds (0 disables).

entries.name: TimeOfDayMinutes
entries.comment: Minutes since midnight, 0..1439.

entries.name: WorldSeed
entries.comment: World generation seed — replicated so client-side procedural logic matches.

entries.name: bPostGameActive
entries.comment: True once any ending has been chosen — post-game free roam is live.

entries.name: SpawnRadius
entries.comment: cm-radius around the player pawn where new hostiles can spawn.

entries.name: TargetGloomfangPopulation
entries.comment: Target wild population for Echo_Gloomfang (Quest 5 objective target).

entries.name: TargetEmberfangPopulation
entries.comment: Target wild population for Echo_Emberfang.

entries.name: TargetRimefangPopulation
entries.comment: Batch 5: target wild population for Echo_Rimefang (Frost predator).

entries.name: TargetVoltmawPopulation
entries.comment: Batch 5: target wild population for Echo_Voltmaw (Pulse glass-cannon — kept low).

entries.name: RespawnIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between spawn sweeps.

entries.name: MaxWeight
entries.comment: Maximum carry weight (kg). 0 = unlimited (debug).

entries.name: EquippedItemId
entries.comment: Unequips every slot (weapon + shield).

entries.name: EquippedShieldItemId
entries.comment: Wave 3 shield slot — feeding block mitigation on the combat component.

entries.name: EquippedHelmetItemId
entries.comment: Helmet: extra armor rating + thermal insulation.

entries.name: EquippedExosuitItemId
entries.comment: Exosuit: insulation + stamina regen + carry weight + move speed bonuses.

entries.name: EquippedScannerItemId
entries.comment: Scanner: enables the active hold-to-scan input (journal acceleration).

entries.name: ObservationProgressPerSecond
entries.comment: Observation progress per real second while a creature is in clear view.

entries.name: ObservationDistance
entries.comment: Max distance for observation.

entries.name: ObservationResearchReward
entries.comment: Research points awarded for completing an observation.

entries.name: HostPort
entries.comment: The host's gameplay listen port (from the packet payload — NOT the beacon port).

entries.name: PlayerCount
entries.comment: Players currently connected (from the packet payload).

entries.name: MaxPlayers
entries.comment: Session capacity — the personal-LAN build is 4 players total (PART 1).

entries.name: ThinkIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between think steps.

entries.name: GuardAggroRadius
entries.comment: Hostile-aggro radius for guards (cm).

entries.name: GuardAttackRange
entries.comment: Guard melee reach (cm).

entries.name: PatrolWalkSpeed
entries.comment: Patrol walk speed (cm/s) — villagers stroll.

entries.name: ChaseRunSpeed
entries.comment: Chase run speed (cm/s) — guards sprint when defending the village.

entries.name: WaypointPauseSeconds
entries.comment: Idle pause at each waypoint (seconds).

entries.name: Affinity
entries.comment: Current affinity 0..100 (grows by talking/trading; saved per NPC id).

entries.name: LastTalkAffinityDay
entries.comment: FCR-1-b (M-b5): save-side accessors for the per-day gate stamps.

entries.name: LastTradeAffinityDay
entries.comment: GDP-4 (FCR-1-b): in-world day of the last TRADE affinity gain.

entries.name: HomeLocation
entries.comment: Home anchor location (the spawn vicinity — villages are compact).

entries.name: WorkLocationOffset
entries.comment: Work anchor offset from home (per profession drift).

entries.name: PoiId
entries.comment: POI definition id this marker represents.

entries.name: SweepIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Sweep cadence in seconds (server).

entries.name: bSkeletalBodyActive
entries.comment: True once the skinned body is live (PMC silhouette hidden).

entries.name: ResolveIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between grid re-solves.

entries.name: DamageAmount
entries.comment: Damage payload (resolved by the combat component before spawn).

entries.name: LifetimeSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds before self-destruct (safety net so bolts never live forever).

entries.name: VisualScale
entries.comment: Visual scale of the placeholder bolt (weapon families differ visibly).

entries.name: TrailVfxId
entries.comment: VFX contract id (Antigravity binds NS_AW_Weap_<TrailVfxId> to the trail).

entries.name: StartingQuestId
entries.comment: Quest auto-activated on first play (directive §21 first story beat).

entries.name: PillarIndex
entries.comment: Required attunement order within the puzzle sequence (0 = first).

entries.name: bActivated
entries.comment: Replicated lit state (attuned pillars glow; wrong order resets all).

entries.name: CachedMaxQuantity
entries.comment: Final-audit M-7: cached definition MaxQuantity — RespawnNode restores the full node, not the per-harvest rate.

entries.name: bInfiniteResource
entries.comment: LCP-2: apply the depleted/respawned visual for the current quantity (pure mirror of the server path).

entries.name: IntegrityChecksum
entries.comment: FNV-1a checksum over schema version + timestamp — corruption tripwire.

entries.name: EquippedWeaponId
entries.comment: Wave 3: equipped weapon/shield ids persist across sessions (additive v2 payload).

entries.name: EquippedArmorId
entries.comment: Batch 3 — Item C: equipped torso armor persists (additive, no schema bump).

entries.name: EquippedHelmetId
entries.comment: Advanced equipment slots (additive v3).

entries.name: EndingState
entries.comment: Ending choice as int32-cast EAstrawildEndingState (0 = None = story in play).

entries.name: bPostGameUnlocked
entries.comment: True once any ending was chosen — post-game free-roam flag.

entries.name: NGPlusCycle
entries.comment: NG+ cycle count (0 = fresh run; written by StartNewGamePlus, restored on load).

entries.name: SkiffId
entries.comment: Stable skiff id (Skiff_Dawnstead / Skiff_Driftwood).

entries.name: CruiseSpeed
entries.comment: Cruise speed (cm/s).

entries.name: BoostSpeed
entries.comment: Boost speed (cm/s).

entries.name: TurnRateDegPerSecond
entries.comment: Yaw rate (degrees/s).

entries.name: VerticalSpeed
entries.comment: Climb/descend rate (cm/s).

entries.name: MaxAltitudeAboveGround
entries.comment: Hard flight ceiling above terrain (cm).

entries.name: StratosCoilItemId
entries.comment: Final Run (FR-8): inventory item that raises the ceiling (stack size 1 key item).

entries.name: MinHoverHeight
entries.comment: Minimum hover height above terrain (cm).

entries.name: BoardRange
entries.comment: Mount range (cm) — generous so boarding from the pontoons feels good.

entries.name: ColdThresholdCelsius
entries.comment: Below this ambient temperature the player suffers cold damage.

entries.name: BaseMaxHealth
entries.comment: Pre-Vigor base max health (tunable; the level multiplier scales this).

entries.name: Resolution
entries.comment: Grid quads per side (128 default -> ~6.25m spacing on an 800m tile).

entries.name: MinutesPerRealSecond
entries.comment: In-world minutes advanced per real second.

entries.name: CaptureResilience
entries.comment: 0 = very easy to capture, 1 = almost impossible. Scales the weaken bonus.

entries.name: Hunger
entries.comment: 0..100, lower = hungrier.

entries.name: Energy
entries.comment: 0..100, lower = more tired.

entries.name: Mood
entries.comment: 0..100, lower = unhappy (affects work + growth).

entries.name: Affinity
entries.comment: 0..2; 1 = baseline, 2 = twice as effective.

entries.name: Health
entries.comment: Player survival vitals (directive §11).

entries.name: Temperature
entries.comment: World temperature as felt by the player, Celsius.

entries.name: StatusId
entries.comment: A runtime status effect instance (directive §11/§12).

entries.name: DamagePerSecond
entries.comment: Optional periodic damage tick.

entries.name: SpeedMultiplier
entries.comment: Optional movement speed multiplier while active.

entries.name: Bond
entries.comment: 0..100 — deepens with time, feeding and shared combat (directive §4 Relationship).

entries.name: IllnessId
entries.comment: SCP Phase 9 (additive): active illness id (NAME_None = healthy).

entries.name: TargetId
entries.comment: Target id: item id, recipe id, tech id, echo definition id, location name...

entries.name: ProgressCount
entries.comment: Runtime progress — not saved in definition data assets.

entries.name: CropSeedId
entries.comment: Crop seed item (NAME_None on empty plots).

entries.name: CropState
entries.comment: Crop state as uint8-cast EAstrawildCropState (0 = Empty).

entries.name: CropGrowth
entries.comment: Crop growth 0..1.

entries.name: bCropFertilized
entries.comment: True while the plot is composted (x2 growth).

entries.name: DungeonId
entries.comment: Stable dungeon id (matches the generator's DungeonId).

entries.name: bCompleted
entries.comment: True when every room (including the boss room) is cleared.

entries.name: ElapsedWorldMinutes
entries.comment: Minutes of in-world time since campaign start.

entries.name: QuestId
entries.comment: Quest runtime state (directive §25).

entries.name: EchoDefinitionId
entries.comment: Field journal knowledge entry (directive §20).

entries.name: ObservationProgress
entries.comment: Observation progress 0..100 — full observation unlocks capture bonus.

entries.name: SiteId
entries.comment: Stable site id (bootstrapper-placed sites use fixed ids; player-built use guids).

entries.name: StoredOutput
entries.comment: Output accumulated but not yet collected.

entries.name: bHasRobot
entries.comment: True when a utility robot mans this site.

entries.name: OutputQuantity
entries.comment: Output produced per completed work cycle (definition default 1).

entries.name: OwnerPlayerId
entries.comment: Utility drone snapshot (save schema v3).

entries.name: BatteryRemainingSeconds
entries.comment: Battery seconds remaining at save time (modules extend the capacity).

entries.name: OwnerPlayerId
entries.comment: Utility robot snapshot (save schema v3).

entries.name: AssignedSiteId
entries.comment: Site id the robot was working at save time.

entries.name: RobotDefinitionId
entries.comment: Robot definition id (specialized chassis: mining/farming/defense).

entries.name: StoredEnergy
entries.comment: Aggregate energy buffered in the grid's batteries (power-seconds).

entries.name: EventId
entries.comment: Definition id of the event.

entries.name: EndAbsoluteMinute
entries.comment: In-world minute the event ends (0 = not time-limited).

entries.name: Location
entries.comment: Location payload (supply crate / meteor crater / signal marker).

entries.name: NextRollAbsoluteMinute
entries.comment: Absolute in-world minute of the next scheduled roll (deterministic resumption).

entries.name: AbilityId
entries.comment: Stable ability id (Ability_XXX).

entries.name: Power
entries.comment: Damage (offensive/debuff DoT scale) or heal amount (restore).

entries.name: UnlockLevel
entries.comment: Echo level required before the ability is known.

entries.name: StatusId
entries.comment: Optional status applied on resolve (target for debuff, self for defensive/mobility).

entries.name: StatusSpeedMultiplier
entries.comment: Movement speed multiplier carried by the applied status.

entries.name: ResonanceId
entries.comment: Stable resonance id (Resonance_XXX).

entries.name: DamageMitigation
entries.comment: Fraction of incoming damage removed from every party Echo (0.08 = 8%).

entries.name: AbilityPowerBonus
entries.comment: Fraction added to offensive/restore ability power of party Echoes (0.10 = 10%).

entries.name: StatusPotencyBonus
entries.comment: Fraction added to debuff status damage/duration applied by party Echoes (0.10 = 10%).

entries.name: Level
entries.comment: GDP-3: live state of one attribute.

entries.name: NPCId
entries.comment: GDP-4: NPC relationship persistence (additive schema v5 field).

entries.name: PlayerKey
entries.comment: Stable per-player key (LCP-4 GetPlayerKey; NAME_None = single-player row).

entries.name: HuntId
entries.comment: Hunt contract id.

entries.name: Defeats
entries.comment: Defeats counted toward the current round (resets on claim).

entries.name: PlayerKey
entries.comment: Stable per-player identity (player name; slot fallback). NAME_None rows never match a live player.

entries.name: SpecialAttackCooldownSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between special volleys (phase 3 halves this — enrage pressure).

entries.name: BoltCount
entries.comment: Energy bolts per volley (fanned around the target).

entries.name: BlastCount
entries.comment: Telegraphed blasts per volley (phase 2+; the first sits on the player, the rest ring around them).

entries.name: SpecialBlastRadius
entries.comment: AoE blast radius (cm).

entries.name: HazardWaveCount
entries.comment: Hazards spawned per hazard wave (phase 2+, ring around the arena center).

entries.name: HazardDamagePerSecond
entries.comment: Damage per second of each spawned arena hazard.

entries.name: SummonSpeciesId
entries.comment: Phase-2 summon species override (the room's explicit FR-7 override still wins).

entries.name: FollowDistance
entries.comment: Hover distance maintained from the owner (cm).

entries.name: HoverHeight
entries.comment: Hover height above the owner's capsule center (cm).

entries.name: FollowInterpSpeed
entries.comment: Movement interpolation speed (higher = snappier follow).

entries.name: BobAmplitude
entries.comment: Bobbing amplitude (cm) — cosmetic hover wobble.

entries.name: ScanIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between auto-scan pulses.

entries.name: ScanRadius
entries.comment: Radius the scanner pulse covers (cm).

entries.name: ScanProgressPerPulse
entries.comment: Observation progress added per pulse per creature in range.

entries.name: HarvestIntervalSeconds
entries.comment: Seconds between auto-harvest attempts.

entries.name: HarvestRadius
entries.comment: Radius the harvester arm covers (cm).

entries.name: BaseBatterySeconds
entries.comment: Base deployed battery capacity (seconds) — modules extend it.

entries.name: BatteryRemainingSeconds
entries.comment: Battery seconds remaining (drains server-side while deployed).

entries.name: OwnerPlayerId
entries.comment: Weak owner — dead/absent owner grounds the drone (no-op tick).

entries.name: MoveInterpSpeed
entries.comment: Movement interpolation speed toward the work site.

entries.name: StandoffDistance
entries.comment: Stand-off distance from the site center (cm).

entries.name: RobotDefinitionId
entries.comment: Robot definition id (specialist chassis); NAME_None = general-purpose frame.

entries.name: OwnerPlayerId
entries.comment: Site id snapshot for save/load re-linking.

entries.name: VillageId
entries.comment: Stable settlement id (Village_Dawnstead / Village_DriftwoodLanding).

entries.name: HutCount
entries.comment: Huts in the ring (visual density).

entries.name: VillageRadius
entries.comment: Ring radius (cm).

entries.name: bCoastal
entries.comment: True → dock planks instead of a palisade (fishing hamlet flavour).

entries.name: TemperatureOffset
entries.comment: Ambient temperature offset in Celsius.

entries.name: SelectionWeight
entries.comment: Relative weight in the random transition pool.

entries.name: VisibilityMultiplier
entries.comment: Visibility/sight perception multiplier (fog lowers it).

entries.name: WeatherChangeIntervalMinutes
entries.comment: Minutes of in-world time each weather regime holds before a transition roll.

entries.name: WorkRange
entries.comment: Working range for assigned Echoes.

entries.name: OutputItemId
entries.comment: Item produced by this site.

entries.name: SecondsPerOutput
entries.comment: Seconds of effective work per produced item (base).

entries.name: bRequiresPower
entries.comment: Requires power from the grid to run at full speed.

entries.name: RobotWorkRate
entries.comment: Fixed work rate contributed by a manned utility robot (no needs, power-gated).

entries.name: OutputQuantity
entries.comment: Output produced per completed cycle (definition default 1).

entries.name: StoredOutput
entries.comment: True when at least one worker is currently assigned.

entries.name: TerrainResolution
entries.comment: Terrain quads per tile side (~6.25m spacing at 128).

entries.name: bBuildTerrain
entries.comment: Master toggles for perf tuning / test worlds.

entries.name: bBuildBiomeDressing
entries.comment: Production V2 Batch 2: procedural biome dressing (trees/rocks/grass per zone).

entries.name: bEnableAtmosphere
entries.comment: Production V2 Batch 2: day/night fog + sun color grading + weather coupling.

entries.name: ResourceNodeCount
entries.comment: Legacy knobs kept for compatibility — now scale the Dawn Fields population.

entries.name: RollIntervalMinutes
entries.comment: In-world minutes between scheduling rolls (default ~5 hours).

entries.name: MaxConcurrentEvents
entries.comment: Max events running at once (raid + surge together is plenty).

entries.name: BaseHeight
entries.comment: Terrain base offset in centimeters.

entries.name: HeightAmplitude
entries.comment: Terrain amplitude in centimeters.

entries.name: RidgeBlend
entries.comment: 0 = smooth rolling hills, 1 = fully ridged mountains.

entries.name: ThreatLevel
entries.comment: 1 (safe) .. 4 (endgame wilds).
